subject: Mutual Action Plan proposal — stakeholder assignments & timeline options
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@genomicshealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan proposal — stakeholder assignments & timeline options

Emma — thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on owners, milestones, and a realistic close window. I pulled together two timeline options based on what we discussed. Please confirm which option looks closest to your internal capacity and who should own each milestone on your side.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v0.1.xlsx (attachment)

Summary (high level)
- Objective: 6-week pilot to validate inference latency & cost for our variant workloads, then move to reserved capacity if metrics meet the success criteria.
- Key success criteria: average p99 latency < 350ms for canonical prompts; model cost < $0.015/token for production mix; integration tests passing.

Proposed milestones & tentative owners
1) Kickoff & requirements capture — Week 0 (Owner: Emma / Genomics Health Product)
2) Security & compliance checklist — Week 1–2 (Owner: Genomics Health Security; Redwood: Rishi)
3) PoC environment setup (VPN + test data) — Week 1–2 (Owner: Redwood Engineering: Rishi)
4) Pilot run & evaluation — Week 3–5 (Owner: Genomics Product + Redwood CS)
5) Procurement & contract finalization — parallel (Owner: Genomics Procurement: TBD; Redwood Legal)

Timeline options (pick one):
- Option A (accelerated): 6-week path — Target close: 2027-05-28 (requires procurement lead + SOC2 evidence in <10 business days)
- Option B (standard): 10-week path — Target close: 2027-06-30 (more buffer for internal approvals and scheduling)

Open dependencies / risks
- SOC 2/attestation evidence delivery (security team to confirm date)
- VPN/secure data ingress window — IT scheduling from your side
- Procurement lead availability for contract redlines

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement contact and the stakeholder who should own security/compliance reviews? If Option A is desirable, please confirm procurement feasibility for late-May close. I’m happy to loop in our legal and solutions folks once you confirm names.

Thanks — I’ve attached a one-page MAP and a suggested meeting cadence. If it helps, I can send a short version with only milestones and owners for your procurement team.

—
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@genomicshealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Bryan Chen <bryan.chen@genomicshealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal — stakeholder assignments & timeline options

Neha — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. I reviewed with our product and procurement leads this morning. A few quick notes:

- Procurement lead: Bryan Chen (cc'd) should be the primary contact for contracting and commercial terms.
- Security/Compliance: I'll confirm our security owner but we will need SOC2 evidence and a short list of required artifacts.
- Timeline preference: We like Option A (accelerated) but I need to run it by CTO and procurement to confirm they can meet a late-May close. Can we tentatively plan for target close = 2027-05-20 and I’ll confirm by EOD Monday? That gives Bryan a little more runway to coordinate PO/contract routing.

Quote: "On Fri, Apr 10, 2027 at 03:12 PM, Neha Kapoor wrote:"
> Emma — thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) ...

I’ve asked Bryan to flag any contract clauses early. Also, we have a VPN approval step that might add 3–5 business days; I'll surface that if it looks like a blocker.

Thanks — I’ll confirm the security owner and the internal decision timeline by Monday.

—
Emma Lawson
Head of Product 
Genomics Health
emma.lawson@genomicshealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2288

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan proposal — stakeholder assignments & timeline options

Neha — I can take point on the security/compliance milestone from our side. I’ll prep a short SOC2 evidence packet request and coordinate with our SOC team to ensure we can surface the artifacts Emma needs. I’ve attached a checklist I typically send to prospects to speed up the review.

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.docx (attachment)

Action items for Redwood:
- I’ll update the MAP to call out specific artifacts (Type II report, control matrix excerpt, data retention policy) and set an expected delivery window.
- Confirm PoC VPN steps and provide a routing diagram for their infra team to review.

Marissa — can you add a line in the MAP for the legal redlines we typically expect (standard IP/data clauses + indemnity language)? I want the procurement path to be explicit so Bryan knows the likely ask list.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Emma / Bryan — thanks for the quick responses and Bryan for jumping in. I updated the MAP with the procurement owner (Bryan) and a security artifact list per Rishi's note. I also tightened the accelerated target close to 2027-05-24 to allow for procurement routing and for Genomics Health's VPN scheduling (gives ~8 business days). Attached is version 1.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (attachment)

Next steps
- Confirm: Emma to confirm internal sign-off and final security owner by Monday EOD (2027-04-12).
- Schedule: I’ll send a 30-min sync for early next week to align owners and review the SOC2 artifact list — propose: Tue 2027-04-13 10:00 AM PT. Please accept/adjust.
- Procurement: Bryan to surface any top-of-the-doc redlines; Marissa will own the initial legal commentary.

If everyone is aligned, I’ll convert the MAP to shared Drive and create a short version specifically for procurement. Calendly: https://calendly.com/neha-redwood/30min

Thanks all — excited to get this moving.
